content.title: Use the published-books browse link on the home page to reach the catalog page
content.intent: Prove that a visitor can leave the home page for the published-books showcase through the dedicated browse link and land on `/books`.
content.technique_notes: Applied happy-path coverage. Kept this as a distinct scenario because the source promises a different destination family (`/books`) from the author-entry controls, so the selected link changes the outcome. No equivalence-class parameters, boundary, negative, covering-array, or dependency expansion applied because the route has one control and one expected outcome with no constrained input. Budget ceiling 8 applied; this scenario ranked 2/3 and was kept with no eviction.
